# Vedam School of Technology

> Vedam School of Technology is a new-age private computer science college in India, offering a 4-year on-campus undergraduate program in Computer Science with a specialisation in Artificial Intelligence. The BTech degree is awarded by UGC-approved partner universities like Ajeenkya DY Patil University (ADYPU) in Pune and Sushant University in Gurugram. Vedam is known for its industry-driven curriculum, hands-on coding from Day 1, instructors by engineers from Microsoft, Amazon, and other MAANG companies, and selective admission with only the top 5% of applicants offered a seat.

## Key Information

- Type: New age college
- Founded: 2025
- Headquarters: India
- Flagship Program: 4-year undergraduate programme in Computer Science with AI specialisation (CS(AI)), a BTech degree by UGC-approved universities

- Campuses:
  - Pune (Lohegaon) - partner: Ajeenkya DY Patil University (ADYPU)
  - Gurugram (Delhi NCR) - partner: Sushant University

- Degree: Bachelor of Technology (BTech), awarded by UGC-approved partner universities
- Program Duration: 4 years, full-time, on-campus
- Specialisation: Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence
- Total Fee: Around 18 lakhs (4-year program)
- Application Fee: INR 1,000
- Seat Blocking Fee: INR 50,000 (adjusted against first-semester fee)
- Acceptance Rate: ~5% (highly selective)
- Eligibility: All the students who appeared for 12th exam in 2025, 2026 with PCM (>50% in PCM & 12th boards Overall) are eligible.
- Entrance Exam: Vedam Scholastic Aptitude Test (VSAT) and performance-based selection are also available for high-merit applicants
- Recognitions: UGC-approved partner universities, NAAC-accredited, NIRF-ranked partner institutions

## What Makes Vedam Different

Vedam is a new age college built to redefine engineering education in India. Unlike traditional engineering colleges that rely on lecture-heavy, theory-first curricula, Vedam's programme emphasises the following:

- Coding from Day 1 where students write 100,000+ lines of code over 4 years
- AI-first curriculum designed with inputs from Microsoft, Amazon, and other MAANG engineers
- Hands-on projects, paid internships, and real-world product building
- Selective peer group with only top 5% of applicants admitted
- Personal MacBook for every student
- Mentorship from industry leaders and startup founders
- Preparation for global tech competitions like Google Summer of Code (GSoC), LFX
- Placements focused on top tech companies, startups, and MAANG roles

## Programs

- [CS(AI) Programme at ADYPU Pune](https://www.vedam.org/program/vst-adypu-pune): 4-year on-campus programme in computer science with AI specialisation, delivered by Vedam at the ADYPU Lohegaon campus in Pune. B.Tech degree awarded by Ajeenkya DY Patil University (UGC-approved).

- [CS(AI) Programme at Sushant University Gurugram](https://www.vedam.org/program/vst-gurugram): 4-year on-campus program in computer science with AI specialisation, delivered by Vedam at the Sushant University campus in Gurugram, Delhi NCR. B.Tech degree awarded by Sushant University (UGC-approved).

### Admission Steps

1. Apply online and reserve your VSAT slot
2. Take the Vedam Scholastic Aptitude Test (VSAT) — or skip directly to the interview if you qualify for direct admission
3. Appear for the personal interview
4. Receive admission results within 7 days
5. Block your seat by paying INR 50,000 (adjusted against first-semester fee)

### Performance-Based Selection

Students with strong academic profiles, JEE rankings, or proven technical achievements may qualify for performance based admission — skipping the VSAT and going straight to the personal interview.

## Scholarships

Vedam offers three scholarship categories worth up to 100% of tuition:

- Merit-Based Scholarship: Up to 100% for academic and technical excellence
- Women in Tech Scholarship: Up to 20% empowering and supporting women in technology
- Need-Based Scholarship: Up to 30% financial assistance for deserving students

## Fees & Financing

- Total program fee: Around INR 18 lakhs
- Application fee: INR 1,000
- Seat blocking fee: INR 50,000 (adjusted against first-semester fee)
- Hostel and accommodation available at partner university campuses
- Education loans available at low-cost EMI through financing partners
- Scholarships up to 100% available based on merit, gender, and need

## Curriculum Highlights

- AI-first curriculum aligned with industry needs
- Coding from Day 1
- Industry-led coursework with input from MAANG engineers
- Annual industry certifications
- 6-month paid internship
- Preparation for global competitions (GSoC, ICPC, LFX)
- Capstone projects and product-building experience
- Soft skills, leadership, and entrepreneurship training

## Career Outcomes

Graduates of Vedam's CS (AI) programme are prepared for roles such as the following:

- Software Engineer
- AI/ML Engineer
- Data Scientist / Data Analyst
- Backend / Full-Stack Developer
- Technical Product Manager
- Startup Founder / Co-founder
- Research Engineer

Top hiring categories include MAANG companies (Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix, Google), Indian unicorns, AI-first startups, and global tech firms.

## About the Partner Universities

### Ajeenkya DY Patil University (ADYPU), Pune

A UGC-approved private university located in Pune, Maharashtra. NAAC-accredited and NIRF-ranked. Vedam delivers the CS(AI) program at the ADYPU Lohegaon campus. The BTech degree is awarded by ADYPU.

- Location: DY Patil University Road, Airport Road, Lohegaon, Pune, Maharashtra
- Recognition: UGC-approved, NAAC-accredited
- Campus: Modern infrastructure with hostels, labs, sports facilities, and security

### Sushant University, Gurugram

A UGC-approved private university located in Gurugram, Haryana. NAAC-accredited. Vedam delivers the CS(AI) program at the Sushant University campus, located near Cyber City and Golf Course Road in Delhi NCR. The BTech degree is awarded by Sushant University.

- Location: Gurugram, Delhi NCR, Haryana
- Recognition: UGC-approved, NAAC-accredited
- Campus: Located near India's startup and corporate hub just minutes from Cyber City and Golf Course Road
